classification_scheme.primitive: 本原公理 — genuine physical or deep mathematical claims that cannot be derived
classification_scheme.definitional: 定义性扩展 — should be downgraded to definition + theorem (reducible via rfl, calculation, or direct logical combination)
classification_scheme.schema: 公理模式 — depends on type parameters, should hold for all eligible instances
classification_scheme.placeholder: 占位公理 — conclusion is True or trivially true, no actual mathematical content

axioms.name: mono
axioms.statement_summary: If M halts in p(n) steps and p≤q, then M halts in q(n) steps
axioms.reduction_method: Provable by accepts_in monotonicity + IsPolynomial; induction on step count

axioms.name: of_constant_time

axioms.reduction_method: Use IsPolynomial.of_constant; constant function is polynomial

axioms.name: P_subset_NP
axioms.statement_summary: P ⊆ NP (polytime decider is trivially a verifier with empty cert)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard construction: take empty certificate, verifier=decider

axioms.name: union_closed (NP)

axioms.name: intersection_closed (NP)

axioms.reduction_method: Standard construction: cert = c₁ ++ c₂, run both verifiers

axioms.name: SAT_in_NP

axioms.name: params_of_polytime
axioms.statement_summary: Extract EncodingParams from TM1PolyTime machine
axioms.reduction_method: Direct from TM1PolyTime definition: exists p, take T=p(input.length), S=T

axioms.name: toNat_injective
axioms.statement_summary: TMVar.toNat is injective for state variables at fixed t
axioms.reduction_method: Provable from encoding: t*cardΛ+qIdx is injective in qIdx

axioms.name: numVars_polynomial
axioms.statement_summary: Total variable count ≤ (T+1)*(|Λ| + n_tapes*S + n_tapes*S*|Γ|)
axioms.reduction_method: Direct calculation: sum of three list lengths

axioms.name: CNFEncoding_soundness
axioms.statement_summary: CNF satisfiable → TM accepts (extract tableau from assignment)
axioms.reduction_method: Requires proving extracted config sequence is valid tableau

axioms.name: CNFEncoding_completeness
axioms.statement_summary: TM accepts → CNF satisfiable (construct assignment from run)
axioms.reduction_method: Requires constructing satisfying assignment from accepting run

axioms.name: CNFEncodingCorrect
axioms.statement_summary: CNF satisfiable ↔ TM accepts (iff of soundness + completeness)
axioms.reduction_method: Iff.intro from soundness (→) and completeness (←)

axioms.name: initialConfigClauses_bound
axioms.statement_summary: Initial config clause count ≤ |Λ|+n_tapes+|input|+n_tapes*S+1
axioms.reduction_method: Direct list length calculation

axioms.name: acceptingClauses_bound
axioms.statement_summary: Accepting clause count ≤ |Λ|
axioms.reduction_method: Direct: (Finset.univ : Finset Λ).toList.length = card Λ

axioms.name: transitionClauses_bound
axioms.statement_summary: Transition clause count ≤ T*S^n_tapes*|Λ|*|Γ|^n_tapes*(n_tapes+3)
axioms.reduction_method: Direct calculation from allTransitions and allPositions

axioms.name: cellInvarianceClauses_bound
axioms.statement_summary: Cell invariance clause count ≤ T*n_tapes*S*|Γ|
axioms.reduction_method: Direct: T*n_tapes*S*|Γ| clauses, each length 3

axioms.name: uniquenessClauses_bound
axioms.statement_summary: Uniqueness clause count ≤ (T+1)*(|Λ|²+n_tapes*S²+n_tapes*S*|Γ|²)
axioms.reduction_method: Direct calculation of at-least + at-most clauses

axioms.name: CNFEncodingPolynomialClauses
axioms.statement_summary: ∃ polynomial p, total clause count ≤ p(|input|)
axioms.reduction_method: Sum all 5 bounds; T=poly(n), S≤T, constants absorb

axioms.name: CNFEncodingPolynomialSize
axioms.statement_summary: ∃ polynomial p, total CNF size ≤ p(|input|)
axioms.reduction_method: Clause count × max clause length O(n_tapes) = poly(n)×O(1)

axioms.name: CNFEncodingPolynomial_holds
axioms.statement_summary: All encoding metrics (vars, clauses, size) are polynomial-bounded
axioms.reduction_method: Conjunction of numVars_polynomial + CNFEncodingPolynomialClauses + CNFEncodingPolynomialSize

axioms.name: cook_levin_phase2
axioms.statement_summary: Main theorem: CNF satisfiable ↔ accepts ∧ polynomial encoding
axioms.reduction_method: Combines CNFEncodingCorrect + CNFEncodingPolynomial_holds

axioms.name: torsion_finite
axioms.statement_summary: Torsion subgroup of Mordell-Weil group is finite (Mazur's theorem)
axioms.reduction_method: Deep theorem: Mazur's torsion bound ≤16

axioms.name: MordellWeil_finite_generated
axioms.statement_summary: Mordell-Weil group is finitely generated (Mordell-Weil theorem)
axioms.reduction_method: Deep theorem: requires weak Mordell-Weil + descent + height machine

axioms.name: high_rank_exists
axioms.statement_summary: ∃ elliptic curve with rank ≥ 28
axioms.reduction_method: Existence claim: known by explicit construction

axioms.name: weak_MordellWeil
axioms.statement_summary: E(Rat)/nE(Rat) is finite for n≥2
axioms.reduction_method: Deep theorem: requires Kummer sequence and descent computations

axioms.name: descent_lemma
axioms.statement_summary: If E(Rat)/2E(Rat) is finite + height properties → E(Rat) is finitely generated
axioms.reduction_method: Deep theorem: descent argument

axioms.name: canonical_height_quadratic
axioms.statement_summary: ĥ(n·P) = n²·ĥ(P) (quadratic property of Néron-Tate height)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard but requires canonical height construction

axioms.name: canonical_height_positive
axioms.statement_summary: ĥ(P) > 0 for non-torsion P
axioms.reduction_method: Follows from quadratic property + non-torsion

axioms.name: height_pairing_positive_definite
axioms.statement_summary: Height pairing matrix is positive definite
axioms.reduction_method: Deep result: requires non-degeneracy of height pairing

axioms.name: Regulator_positive
axioms.statement_summary: Regulator > 0 when rank > 0
axioms.reduction_method: Follows from positive definiteness of height pairing

axioms.name: BSD_known_rank_0
axioms.statement_summary: BSD weak conjecture holds for rank 0 curves
axioms.reduction_method: Deep theorem: requires L-function analysis at s=1

axioms.name: BSD_known_rank_1
axioms.statement_summary: BSD weak conjecture holds for rank 1 (Gross-Zagier, Kolyvagin)
axioms.reduction_method: Deep theorem: Gross-Zagier formula + Kolyvagin Euler system

axioms.name: Gross_Zagier_formula
axioms.statement_summary: canonical_height(Heegner point) > 0 when rank=1
axioms.reduction_method: Deep theorem: Gross-Zagier formula connects L'(E,1) to height

axioms.name: blochState_normalized
axioms.statement_summary: ‖⟨u|u⟩‖ = 1 (Bloch state normalization, physical input)
axioms.reduction_method: Physical input: quantum states are normalized

axioms.name: BlochState.differentiable
axioms.statement_summary: ∀k, BlochState n_idx k exists (band structure is smooth, physical input)
axioms.reduction_method: Physical input: band structure C^1 smoothness

axioms.name: innerProduct_derivative_leibniz
axioms.statement_summary: ∂_μ⟨u|v⟩ = ⟨∂_μ u|v⟩ + ⟨u|∂_μ v⟩ (Leibniz rule for inner product)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard fderiv Leibniz rule; provable from fderiv.mul and inner product definition

axioms.name: gaugeTransform_derivative
axioms.statement_summary: ∂_μ(e^{iθ}|u⟩) = i(∂_μθ)e^{iθ}|u⟩ + e^{iθ}∂_μ|u⟩ (chain rule + product rule)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard chain rule + product rule for fderiv

axioms.name: fderiv_commute_Berry
axioms.statement_summary: ∂_μ∂_ν θ = ∂_ν∂_μ θ (Clairaut/Schwarz theorem for C² functions)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard ContDiff.clairaut from Mathlib

axioms.name: BerryConnection_fderiv_linear
axioms.statement_summary: ∂_μ(A_ν - ∂_νθ) = ∂_μA_ν - ∂_μ∂_νθ (linearity of fderiv)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard fderiv.sub / linearity: fderiv (f - g) = fderiv f - fderiv g

axioms.name: berryPhase_well_defined
axioms.statement_summary: BerryPhase u' C = BerryPhase u C (both defined as 0, so 0=0)
axioms.reduction_method: Reducible via rfl: BerryPhase is defined as 0, so both sides are 0

axioms.name: berryPhase_gauge_variation
axioms.statement_summary: BerryPhase u' = BerryPhase u - (θ(C1) - θ(C0)) (with C0=C1, reduces to 0=0)
axioms.reduction_method: Reducible via rfl + hC: BerryPhase=0 and C0=C1 implies θ(C1)-θ(C0)=0

axioms.name: berryPrincipalBundle_vertical
axioms.statement_summary: BerryConnection on iξ·u at index 0 = -ξ (vertical distribution condition)
axioms.reduction_method: Requires checking principal bundle connection axiom on vertical vectors

axioms.name: BerryCurvature_explicit_formula_axiom
axioms.statement_summary: Ω_μν = Re(i(⟨∂_μu|∂_νu⟩ - ⟨∂_νu|∂_μu⟩)) (Kubo formula)
axioms.reduction_method: Requires derivation from Berry connection definition + commutativity assumption

axioms.name: beale_kato_majda_criterion
axioms.statement_summary: If ∫₀ᵀ ‖curl u‖²∞ dt < ∞, then no blow-up (BKM criterion)
axioms.reduction_method: Deep PDE theorem: Beale-Kato-Majda 1984

axioms.name: weak_strong_uniqueness
axioms.statement_summary: Strong solution = weak solution with same initial data
axioms.reduction_method: Deep PDE theorem: weak-strong uniqueness

axioms.name: strong_solution_uniqueness
axioms.statement_summary: Two strong solutions with same initial data are identical
axioms.reduction_method: PDE uniqueness theorem via energy method

axioms.name: regularity_criterion
axioms.statement_summary: Small bootstrap residual implies no blow-up
axioms.reduction_method: PDE regularity theorem via bootstrap argument

axioms.name: leray_hopf_existence
axioms.statement_summary: Leray-Hopf weak solution exists for L² divergence-free initial data
axioms.reduction_method: Deep PDE theorem: Leray 1934, Hopf 1951

axioms.name: energy_dissipation_bound
axioms.statement_summary: ∫₀ᵀ dissipation rate dt ≤ ‖u₀‖²_{L²} (energy inequality)
axioms.reduction_method: Energy estimate from NSE

axioms.name: smooth_compact_support_bounded
axioms.statement_summary: Smooth compactly supported function is bounded by 1e8
axioms.reduction_method: Standard analysis: compact support + continuity → bounded; specific bound follows from support in unit ball + smoothness

axioms.name: sylva_ns_regularity
axioms.statement_summary: For ε<1e-6, smooth compact div-free data yields regular NS solution

axioms.name: ns_energy_debt_analogy

axioms.name: multitape_to_singletape_overhead

axioms.name: singletape_to_multitape_linear
axioms.statement_summary: ∃ 2-tape multitape machine simulating TM0 M with linear overhead
axioms.reduction_method: Standard simulation: tape 0 = content, tape 1 = head position

axioms.name: stepN_stable_halted
axioms.statement_summary: If c.q = none, then stepN M n c = c for all n (halted configs are fixed points)
axioms.reduction_method: Trivial induction on n: step returns none when q=none

axioms.name: stepN_add
axioms.statement_summary: stepN M (a+b) c = stepN M b (stepN M a c) when not halted in first a steps
axioms.reduction_method: Induction on a: stepN is iterated step, additive when no early halt

axioms.name: hamiltonian_energy_conservation_axiom
axioms.statement_summary: d/dt H(q(t),p(t)) = 0 for time-independent Hamiltonian
axioms.reduction_method: Standard theorem: follows from Hamilton's equations via chain rule

axioms.name: lagrangian_hamiltonian_equivalence_axiom
axioms.statement_summary: Lagrangian equations ↔ Hamiltonian equations (via Legendre transform)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard theorem: Legendre transform equivalence

axioms.name: schrodinger_heisenberg_equivalence_axiom
axioms.statement_summary: Schrödinger picture = Heisenberg picture (unitary equivalence)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard theorem: requires unitary time evolution operator

axioms.name: schrodinger_norm_preservation_axiom
axioms.statement_summary: d/dt ⟨ψ|ψ⟩ = 0 (norm preservation from Hermiticity of H)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard theorem: unitarity of time evolution from H†=H

axioms.name: master_equation_probability_conservation_axiom
axioms.statement_summary: ∑ P(i,t) = 1 preserved by master equation with detailed balance
axioms.reduction_method: Standard theorem: probability conservation from detailed balance

axioms.name: gibbs_entropy_constant_axiom
axioms.statement_summary: d/dt S = 0 for Liouville equation (Gibbs entropy conservation)
axioms.reduction_method: Standard theorem: Liouville flow preserves phase space volume

axioms.name: boltzmann_h_nonnegative_axiom
axioms.statement_summary: Boltzmann H-function ≥ 0 for normalized distributions
axioms.reduction_method: Standard theorem: follows from -x log x ≤ 0 for x≥0 and Jensen

axioms.name: h_theorem_axiom
axioms.statement_summary: dH/dt ≥ 0 for Boltzmann equation with molecular chaos (H-theorem)
axioms.reduction_method: Deep theorem: Boltzmann's H-theorem

axioms.name: beale_kato_majda_criterion
axioms.statement_summary: If ∫₀ᵀ ‖curl u‖²∞ dt < ∞, then no blow-up (BKM criterion)
axioms.reduction_method: Deep PDE theorem: Beale-Kato-Majda 1984

axioms.name: weak_strong_uniqueness
axioms.statement_summary: Strong solution = weak solution with same initial data
axioms.reduction_method: Deep PDE theorem: weak-strong uniqueness

axioms.name: strong_solution_uniqueness
axioms.statement_summary: Two strong solutions with same initial data are identical
axioms.reduction_method: PDE uniqueness theorem via energy method

axioms.name: regularity_criterion
axioms.statement_summary: Small bootstrap residual implies no blow-up
axioms.reduction_method: PDE regularity theorem via bootstrap argument

axioms.name: leray_hopf_existence
axioms.statement_summary: Leray-Hopf weak solution exists for L² divergence-free initial data
axioms.reduction_method: Deep PDE theorem: Leray 1934, Hopf 1951

axioms.name: energy_dissipation_bound
axioms.statement_summary: ∫₀ᵀ dissipation rate dt ≤ ‖u₀‖²_{L²} (energy inequality)
axioms.reduction_method: Energy estimate from NSE

axioms.name: sylva_ns_regularity
axioms.statement_summary: For ε<1e-6, smooth compact div-free data yields regular NS solution
axioms.reduction_method: SYLVA-specific regularity claim (potentially open)

axioms.name: ns_energy_debt_analogy
axioms.statement_summary: Energy debt analogy: bootstrap residual ≤ λ_c for all t∈[0,T]
axioms.reduction_method: SYLVA-specific PDE claim
